main_measure.name: t of slope of excess 3-bar forward return on forecast, mean_reversion grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with supporting check passed; reject if t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 100 grid cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return on grid bars with forecast < 0 below 0

decided_by: The slope's t is >= 2 and the mean excess 3-bar return on forecast < 0 grid bars is below 0.
reading: Expected side read as the graded relation (short when the 5/30 log volume ratio is below 0, long when above), situation recomputed as close/close[-5]-1 < 0 with the recorded regime used on each window's first 5 bars; the coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over its non-overlapping grid bars of all windows, and the regression is pooled over coins.
